استسقيا (form X)
# اِسْتَسْقَيَا (istasqayā) /is.tas.qa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
# اُسْتُسْقِيَا (ustusqiyā) /us.tus.qi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
# اِسْتَسْقِيَا (istasqiyā) /is.tas.qi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
